Xarray connection

Source: R/connection.R
XarrayConnection-class.Rd

Tables are variables (data variables and coordinates alike). Fields are dimensions, then non-dimension coordinates, then the variable itself. The Python object is reachable at any time via xr_dataset(); this connection is a veneer, not a jail. Create one with dbConnect(); queries are documented with XarrayResult, whole variables with dbReadTable().

Usage

# S4 method for class 'XarrayConnection'
show(object)

# S4 method for class 'XarrayConnection'
dbIsValid(dbObj, ...)

# S4 method for class 'XarrayConnection'
dbDisconnect(conn, ...)

# S4 method for class 'XarrayConnection'
dbGetInfo(dbObj, ...)

# S4 method for class 'XarrayConnection'
dbListTables(conn, ...)

# S4 method for class 'XarrayConnection,character'
dbExistsTable(conn, name, ...)

# S4 method for class 'XarrayConnection,character'
dbListFields(conn, name, ...)

# S4 method for class 'XarrayConnection'
dbBegin(conn, ...)

# S4 method for class 'XarrayConnection'
dbCommit(conn, ...)

# S4 method for class 'XarrayConnection'
dbRollback(conn, ...)

# S4 method for class 'XarrayConnection'
dbDataType(dbObj, obj, ...)

# S4 method for class 'XarrayConnection,character'
dbQuoteIdentifier(conn, x, ...)

# S4 method for class 'XarrayConnection,character'
dbQuoteString(conn, x, ...)

Arguments

object, dbObj, conn

an XarrayConnection

...

unused

name

a variable name

obj

an R object, for dbDataType()

x

character vector to quote

Value

  • show(): called for its output (source, dims, data variables)

  • dbIsValid(): TRUE while the connection is open

  • dbDisconnect(): TRUE, invisibly

  • dbGetInfo(): a list with dbname, db.version (the xarray version), tables (data variables) and sizes (dims)

  • dbListTables(): character, every variable (coordinates included)

  • dbExistsTable(): logical

  • dbListFields(): character, dims, then non-dimension coordinates, then the variable

  • dbDataType(): character, the numpy dtype an R vector maps to

  • dbQuoteIdentifier(), dbQuoteString(): DBI::SQL() holding Python source (ds['name'], 'text')

  • dbBegin(), dbCommit(), dbRollback(): no return, they error

Details

Transactions (dbBegin(), dbCommit(), dbRollback()) are not implemented and error; the intended mapping is icechunk sessions and commits.

Slots

ptr

environment holding the Python handles (xr module, ds object)

dsn

the source string if the connection was opened from one

See also

dbConnect() to open one; XarrayResult for queries; xr_dataset() for the Python object; xrdbi-package for an overview.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
## needs a Python environment with xarray (see ?xrdbi)
f <- system.file("extdata/autotest/trmm.nc", package = "xrdbi")
con <- dbConnect(xarray(), f)
con
dbListTables(con)       # every variable, coordinates included
dbGetInfo(con)$tables   # the data variables
dbListFields(con, "pcp")
dbGetInfo(con)$sizes
dbDisconnect(con)
} # }
